G3360.d: from μῆκος; as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of extent (denoting the terminus, whereas ἄχρι refers especially to the space of time or place intervening) or conjunction):--till, (un-)to, until.

G3159.d: apparently a shortened form of Ματταθίας; Matthias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Matthias.

G3018.d: a form of Λευΐ; Lewis (i.e. Levi), a Christian:--Levi.

G3372.d: probably akin to μέγας; length (literally or figuratively) length.

G3146.d: from μάστιξ; to flog (literally or figuratively):--scourge.

G3370.d: of foreign origin (compare מָדַי); a Median, or inhabitant of Media:--Mede.

G3070.d: properly, feminine of Ludios (of foreign origin) (a Lydian, in Asia Minor); Lydia, a Christian woman:--Lydia.

G3318.d: from μέσος and ποταμός; Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם), a region of Asia:--Mesopotamia.

G3365.d: adverb from a compound of μή and (somebody); by no means:--not so.

G3047.d: probably from (to pour a "libation"); the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter):--southwest.

G3198.d: of Hebrew origin (מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק); Melchisedek (i.e. Malkitsedek), a patriarch:--Melchisedec.

G3332.d: from μετά and αἴρω; to betake oneself, i.e. remove (locally):--depart.

G3111.d: of Latin origin (macellum); a butcher's stall, meat market or provision-shop:--shambles.

G3162.d: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of μάχη; a knife, i.e. dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment:--sword.

G3035.d: from λίθος; stony, i.e. made of stone:--of stone.

G3031.d: from λίβανος; frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it:--censer.

G3403.d: a prolonged form of μνάομαι (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind:--be mindful, remember.

G3088.d: from the base of λευκός; a portable lamp or other illuminator (literally or figuratively):--candle, light.

G3091.d: of Hebrew origin (לוֹט); Lot, a patriarch:--Lot.

G3085.d: from λυτρόω; a ransoming (figuratively):--+ redeemed, redemption.

G3426.d: of Latin origin; a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil):--bushel.

G3486.d: of Hebrew origin (נַחוּם); Naum (i.e. Nachum), an Israelite:--Naum.

G3495.d: from the same as νεανίας; a youth (under forty):--young man.

G3199.d: a primary verb; to be of interest to, i.e. to concern (only third person singular present indicative used impersonally, it matters):--(take) care.

G3467.d: from a compound of the base of μυστήριον and (the face; from ὀπτάνομαι); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly):-- cannot see far off.

G3373.d: from μῆκος; to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge:--grow up.

G3069.d: of Hebrew origin (לֹד); Lydda (i.e. Lod), a place in Palestine:--Lydda.

G3330.d: from μετά and δίδωμι; to give over, i.e. share:--give, impart.

G3468.d: from ("moil"; probably akin to the base of μόλις) and probably (the face; from ὀπτάνομαι); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark:--stripe.

G3474.d: probably from the base of μυστήριον; dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e. heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd:--fool(-ish, X -ishness).

G3054.d: from a compound of λόγος and μάχομαι; to be disputatious (on trifles):--strive about words.

G3377.d: probably from the same base as μασσάομαι and μνάομαι (i.e. , to strive); to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate:--shew, tell.

G3341.d: from μετανοέω; (subjectively) compunction (for guilt, including reformation); by implication, reversal (of (another's) decision):--repentance.

G3425.d: adverb from a primary (toil); with difficulty:--hardly.

G3160.d: probably a shortened form of Ματταθίας (compare מַתַּתָּה); Mattatha (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Mattatha.

G3473.d: from a compound of μωρός and λέγω; silly talk, i.e. buffoonery:--foolish talking.

G3321.d: from a presumed compound of μέσος and οὐρανός; mid-sky:--midst of heaven.

G3359.d: from μετά and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the countenance):--forehead.

G3375.d: a stronger form of μέν; a particle of affirmation (only with ἦ); assuredly:--+ surely.

G3494.d: from a derivative of νέος; a youth (up to about forty years):--young man.

G3116.d: adverb of a compound of μακρός and θυμός; with long (enduring) temper, i.e. leniently:--patiently.

G3479.d: from Ναζαρέθ; a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth:--of Nazareth.

G3317.d: neuter of compound of μέσος and νύξ; midnight (especially as a watch):--midnight.

G3491.d: from or (to float); a boat (of any size):--ship.

G3433.d: probably by variation for μόγις; with difficulty:--hardly, scarce(-ly), + with much work.

G3309.d: from μέριμνα; to be anxious about:--(be, have) care(-ful), take thought.

G3084.d: from λύτρον; to ransom (literally or figuratively):--redeem.

G3033.d: probably from λίψ; Libye, a region of Africa:--Libya.

G3062.d: masculine plural of a derivative of λείπω; remaining ones:--other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest.

G3307.d: from μέρος; to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ:--deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give participle

G3416.d: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian:--Mnason.

G3064.d: genitive case singular of the same as λοιποί; remaining time:--from henceforth.

G3328.d: from μετά and βάλλω; to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion:--change mind.

G3455.d: from a presumed derivative of ( to "moo"); to bellow (roar):--roar.

G3071.d: perhaps remotely from λύκος; Lycaonia, a region of Asia Minor:--Lycaonia.

G3434.d: of Hebrew origin (מֹלֶךְ); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol:--Moloch.

G3446.d: from μορφόω; formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula):--form.

G3053.d: from λογίζομαι; computation, i.e. (figuratively) reasoning (conscience, conceit):--imagination, thought.

G3379.d: from μή and ποτέ; not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps):--if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.

G3371.d: from μή and ἔτι; no further:--any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.

G3488.d: a flower of the same name, from (stupefaction, as a "narcotic"); Narcissus, a Roman:--Narcissus.

G3179.d: from μετά and ἵστημι; to transfer, i.e. carry away, depose or (figuratively) exchange, seduce:--put out, remove, translate, turn away.

G3423.d: from a derivative of μνάομαι; to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth:--espouse.

G3056.d: from λέγω; something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ):--account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work.

G3030.d: of foreign origin (לְבוֹנָה); the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself:--frankincense.

G3315.d: from μεσίτης; to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety):--confirm.

G3381.d: from μή and -πώς; lest somehow:--lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps).

G3075.d: middle voice from a probably derivative of λύω (meaning filth); properly, to soil, i.e. (figuratively) insult (maltreat):--make havock of.

G3405.d: from μισθαποδότης; requital (good or bad):--recompence of reward.

G3115.d: from the same as μακροθυμώς; longanimity, i.e. (objectively) forbearance or (subjectively) fortitude:--longsuffering, patience.

G3036.d: from a compound of λίθος and βάλλω; to throw stones, i.e. lapidate:--stone, cast stones.

G3015.d: from the same as λέπρα; scaly, i.e. leprous (a leper):--leper.

G3123.d: neuter of the comparative of the same as μάλιστα; (adverbially) more (in a greater degree)) or rather:--+ better, X far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather.

G3440.d: neuter of μόνος as adverb; merely:--alone, but, only.

G3392.d: perhaps a primary verb; to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally):--defile.

G3445.d: from the same as μορφή; to fashion (figuratively):--form.

G3020.d: from Λευΐτης; Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites:--Levitical.

G3093.d: of Chaldee origin (compare מִגְדָּל); the tower; Magdala (i.e. Migdala), a place in Palestine:--Magdala.

G3343.d: from μετά and πέμπω; to send from elsewhere, i.e. (middle voice) to summon or invite:--call (send) for.
r: soon as i was sent for

G3172.d: from μέγας; greatness, i.e. (figuratively) divinity (often God himself):--majesty.

G3439.d: from μόνος and γίνομαι; only-born, i.e. sole:--only (begotten, child).

G3464.d: probably of foreign origin (compare מֹר, σμύρνα); "myrrh", i.e. (by implication) perfumed oil:--ointment.

G3354.d: from μέτρον; to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule):--figuratively, to estimate:--measure, mete.

G3469.d: from μῶμος; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit):--blame.

G3152.d: from the base of μάτην; empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol:--vain, vanity.

G3148.d: probably from the base of μασσάομαι (through the idea of contact); a whip (literally, the Roman flagellum for criminals; figuratively, a disease):--plague, scourging.

G3021.d: from λευκός; to whiten:--make white, whiten.

G3049.d: middle voice from λόγος; to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively):--conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on).

G3074.d: perhaps akin to the base of λευκός (from the whitish hair); a wolf:--wolf.

G3077.d: apparently a primary word; sadness:--grief, grievous, + grudgingly, heaviness, sorrow.

G3481.d: of Hebrew origin (נָתָן); Nathan, an Israelite:--Nathan.

G3096.d: from μάγος; to practice magic:--use sorcery.

G3112.d: feminine accusative case singular of μακρός (ὁδός being implied); at a distance (literally or figuratively):--(a-)far (off), good (great) way off.

G3100.d: from μαθητής; intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar:--be disciple, instruct, teach.

G3059.d: from λοίδορος; slander or vituperation:--railing, reproach(-fully).

G3356.d: from a compound of the base of μετρίως and πάθος; to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently):--have compassion.

G3476.d: of Hebrew origin (נַחְשׁוֹן); Naasson (i.e. Nachshon), an Israelite:--Naasson.

G3462.d: from μύρον; to apply (perfumed) unguent to:--anoint.

G3081.d: third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of λύσις and τέλος; impersonally, it answers the purpose, i.e. is advantageous:--it is better.

G3429.d: from μοιχός; (middle voice) to commit adultery:--commit adultery.

G3477.d: probably of Hebrew origin (compare נֹגַהּ); Nangæ (i.e. perhaps Nogach), an Israelite:--Nagge.

G3454.d: perhaps from the same as μυέω (through the idea of tuition); a tale, i.e. fiction ("myth"):--fable.

G3322.d: from μέσος; to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over:--be about the midst.

G3400.d: of Latin origin; a thousand paces, i.e. a "mile":--mile.

G3166.d: from a compound of μέγας and (to boast; akin to αὐξάνω and καυχάομαι); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic):--boast great things.

G3150.d: from ματαιολόγος; random talk, i.e. babble:--vain jangling.

G3178.d: apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. (by implication) intoxication:--drunkenness.

G3399.d: of uncertain origin; Miletus, a city of Asia Minor:--Miletus.

G3161.d: of Hebrew origin (מַתִּתְיָה); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Mattathias.

G3181.d: from μετά and ὅριον; bounded alongside, i.e. contiguous (neuter plural as noun, frontier):--border.

G3453.d: from the base of μυστήριον; to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to teach:--instruct.

G3197.d: of Hebrew origin (מֶלֶךְ with pronominal suffix, my king); Melchi (i.e. Malki), the name of two Israelites:--Melchi.

G3390.d: from μήτηρ and πόλις; a mother city, i.e. "metropolis":--chiefest city.

G3155.d: accusative case of a derivative of the base of μασσάομαι (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment); folly, i.e. (adverbially) to no purpose:--in vain.

G3072.d: adverb from a derivative of Λυκαονία; Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians:--in the speech of Lycaonia.

G3398.d: apparently a primary word; small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity):--least, less, little, small.

G3141.d: from μάρτυς; evidence given (judicially or genitive case):--record, report, testimony, witness.

G3004.d: a primary verb; properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas ἔπω and φημί generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while ῥέω is properly to break silence merely, and λαλέω means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean:--ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter.

G3490.d: from ναῦς and κλῆρος ("clerk"); a captain:--owner of a ship.

G3006.d: apparently a primary word; smooth, i.e. "level":--smooth.

G3131.d: of Hebrew origin (מָן); manna (i.e. man), an edible gum:--manna.

G3137.d: of Hebrew origin (מִרְיָם); Maria or Mariam (i.e. Mirjam), the name of six Christian females:-- Mary.

G3014.d: from the same as λεπίς; scaliness, i.e. "leprosy":--leprosy.

G3324.d: of uncertain derivation; replete (literally or figuratively):--full.

G3320.d: from μέσος and τοῖχος; a partition (figuratively):--middle wall.

G3406.d: from μισθόω and ἀποδίδωμι; a renumerator:--rewarder.

G3051.d: neuter of λόγιος; an utterance (of God):--oracle.

G3404.d: from a primary (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less:--hate(-ful).

G3358.d: an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree):-- measure.

G3026.d: apparently a primary word; twaddle, i.e. an incredible story:--idle tale.

G3120.d: of uncertain affinity; soft, i.e. fine (clothing); figuratively, a catamite:--effeminate, soft.

G3413.d: of Hebrew origin (מִיכָאֵל); Michael, an archangel:--Michael.

G3349.d: from a compound of μετά and a collateral form of αἴρω or perhaps rather ἀήρ (compare "meteor"); to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious):--be of doubtful mind.

G3436.d: from μολύνω; a stain; i.e. (figuratively) immorality:--filthiness.

G3313.d: from an obsolete but more primary form of (to get as a section or allotment); a division or share (literally or figuratively, in a wide application):--behalf, course, coast, craft, particular (+ -ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort(-what).
